title: apricity-score: list every kit's resolved pads in the compiled timeline (Timeline.kits)
description:
## Intent

The exporter needs each kit's resolved pads even when no track plays the kit. Today the compiler resolves kits (`compile_with`, crates/apricity-score/src/compile.rs, the "kits: sliced kits first" block) but only exposes pads through `TrackInfo.pieces` and level gains through `TrackInfo.level_groups` of tracks that play a whole kit.

## Scope

- Add `Timeline.kits: Vec<KitInfo>` (additive, `skip_serializing_if` empty): name, kind (sliced | drum), and per pad: number or name, `source` index, `src_start`/`src_end`, the level group gain in dB, the pad's `tuning_cents`, and the root pitch (clip `root` or the detected tonic of the region).
- Level gains computed by the same function the tracks use (no second copy of level matching).
- Doc comments on the new types; `apricity compile` output shows the field.

## Out of scope

Any DAW format. Changing level matching.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-score
```
New unit tests in `crates/apricity-score/tests/compile.rs`: a sliced kit and a drum kit that no track plays still appear in `kits`, with the same gains `apricity explain` prints for a track that plays them. Every example still compiles unchanged (`tests/examples.rs`).

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): the compiled timeline lists every kit's pads`. Not breaking (additive field). Web: the typed timeline in `web/src` may add the optional field later; no change needed now.

## Dependencies

None inside the initiative; can start in parallel with the crate chore after M0.
